successCriteria.description: Create `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` exporting a `LeavePolicy` interface with exactly these attributes: `id: string`, `policyName: string`, `leaveType: LeaveType` (imported from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`), `entitlementDays: number`, `accrualRate: number | null`, `maxAccumulation: number | null`, `minimumNoticeDays: number | null`, `requiresManagerApproval: boolean`, `isActive: boolean`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`.
Create `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` exporting a `LeavePolicyQueryParams` type for filtering queries (partial of LeavePolicy fields).

Create `src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts` exporting an `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface declaring these six methods: `findByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`; `findById(id: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`; `findAll(params?: LeavePolicyQueryParams): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`; `create(policy: Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeavePolicy>`; `update(id: string, updates: Partial<Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`; `softDelete(id: string): Promise<boolean>`.

Create `tests/unit/modules/policy/policy.repository.test.ts` with Jest unit tests that verify the `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface shape — confirming all six method signatures exist and accept/return the correct types. Tests should import `LeavePolicy` and `ILeavePolicyRepository` and use TypeScript compile-time checks (e.g., assigning a conforming object to the interface type).
`LeaveType` is imported from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` (Phase 1 dependency). The three enum members are ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY — matching the actual source file.

constraints: All database access must go through repository interfaces (GP-001). This phase only defines the interface; the concrete `PgLeavePolicyRepository` is deferred to a later phase.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks (AGENTS.md).
`LeaveType` must be imported from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` — do not redefine it locally.
The `policy` module is a leaf module with zero dependencies on other modules (ARCHITECTURE.md). Its only external dependency is `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`.
outOfScope: Concrete `PgLeavePolicyRepository` implementation — this phase only defines the `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface.
Controller, routes, validation schemas, and database migrations for the policy module.
Any other module (balance, leave, employee, notification) — policy is a leaf module built in isolation.

ambiguities.description: `LeavePolicyQueryParams` type is specified as a "type for filtering queries" but the exact filterable fields are not enumerated. The intent says it should be a partial of LeavePolicy fields, but doesn't specify which subset.
options: Make it `Partial<Pick<LeavePolicy, 'leaveType' | 'isActive' | 'policyName'>>` — only the most common filter fields

ambiguities.description: `softDelete` returns `Promise<boolean>` — the semantics of the boolean are not specified. Does `true` mean "at least one row was affected" or "the operation completed without error"?
options: `true` = at least one row was soft-deleted (affected rows > 0)
`true` = operation succeeded without throwing (even if no rows matched)
`true` = the entity was found and deactivated
